The alternatives are tempting for identifiable reasons — "5^-1 = -5." (negates base); "5^-1 = -1/5." (negates reciprocal); "5^-1 is undefined." (denies negative exponent). Each of those errors misses what negative exponents requires, so the keyed option stands.

questions.stem: A historical case two-way table grand total is 50; cell is 10; relative frequency percent?
questions.explanation: "20 percent" is correct. The rule behind it: Cell/total. This is the skill the item tests: Compute total from margins. The alternatives are tempting for identifiable reasons — "5 percent" (divides total by count); "10 percent" (uses count as percent); "50 percent" (uses total as percent).
